These are the materials I prepare for the practical classes and seminars I teach as an assistant professor in the Department of Social Medicine and Public Health, MU–Plovdiv. They accompany the courses I assist in, are developed together with my colleagues in the department, and are free for my students and anyone else to use for study.

Pick a **discipline**, then a **language**, and each year is split into two separate collections — *lecture slides* and *student handouts*. The academic-year selector opens on the most recent materials; earlier cohorts stay available as an archive rather than being overwritten. Use the search box to look across everything at once, or click a tag to narrow things down. If you find an error, please [email me](mailto:kostadinr.kostadinov@mu-plovdiv.bg).

::: {.callout-note}
## The official resources

The department's official study resources are:

- **[A Concise Compendium](https://socmed.raredis.org/doku.php?id=en:start)** — the main exam companion and the definitive reference for preparation.
- **[Department SharePoint repository](https://muplovdivbg.sharepoint.com/teams/FacultyofPublicHealth/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?csf=1&web=1&e=LExgmG&fbclid=IwAR2SpPwcopaNurXSVHad93XLYDSO_Kyp1OmLeSVXNp9X5HsZV2McXIjE29M&cid=e2420523-e896-4890-a24e-a322d867164f&FolderCTID=0x012000DAF9907FD71CC142959689FC483FA4AC&id=%2Fteams%2FFacultyofPublicHealth%2FShared%20Documents%2F%D0%A1%D0%BE%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%B0%D0%BB%D0%BD%D0%B0%20%D0%BC%D0%B5%D0%B4%D0%B8%D1%86%D0%B8%D0%BD%D0%B0%20%D0%B8%20%D0%BE%D0%B1%D1%89%D0%B5%D1%81%D1%82%D0%B2%D0%B5%D0%BD%D0%BE%20%D0%B7%D0%B4%D1%80%D0%B0%D0%B2%D0%B5%20-%20Social%20medicine%20and%20public%20health)**
